messages.subject: Rstan on Mac issue
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to set up Rstan on a new machine (Mac). After installing it, I tried running my model but I got some pretty weird warnings and errors. Then I tried the 8 school example and got the same warnings but not the errors.

My regular machine has almost identical hardware and software and Rstan has been working great from day one.

I attached the console output and system information below. Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated!

Saiwing
